title: Discovery resolver Nostr-native subscription hardening
observed_behavior: pkg/discovery/resolver.go exposed WithRefreshInterval and used a ticker to periodically tear down and recreate subscriptions for event delivery.
The resolver subscribed without first using the shared relay metadata/NIP-11 path.
The resolver performed inline NIP-01 checks instead of the shared inbound validation boundary.
intended_behavior: The resolver opens an EOSE-aware live subscription and relies on relay EOSE plus the open event stream instead of refresh timers for historical catch-up and realtime delivery.
The resolver fetches relay NIP-11 metadata before connecting/subscribing when it owns relay setup and handles unavailable metadata explicitly by logging it.
Inbound endpoint events are validated through the shared ValidateInboundEvent helper before resolver-specific kind, author, d-tag, and JSON content validation.
